I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and look are unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and has three cards (General, Notifications, Danger zone) on a white page, with all colours and sizes taken from the tokens. I copied only the tokens I use into the file's `<style>` block, because it has to be self-contained.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available in this folder, so the browser will show the system fallback fonts from the token stack.
- **Buttons:** "Save Changes" is the one primary button. "Delete Workspace" is a secondary outline button with no red, as the file requires.
- **Top row:** `DESIGN.md` puts the primary action on the right of the title row. You asked for "Save Changes" inside the General section and exactly that content, so I left the title row with just the heading.
- **Switches:** "Email me when a request is assigned to me" and "Weekly summary" start on, and "Product updates" starts off. You didn't say which should be on, so that's my guess.
